title: Flood Evacuation and Rescue, Pt. 2
description: B-roll of Soldiers helping with flood evacuation and rescue. Scenes include firetrucks and other emergency vehicles driving through flooded streets, and interview with a commanding officer and footage of Soldiers filling sandbags. Part 2 of 4.
